notes.title: Update has been released
notes.content:
Today, 

a new updated versions of Ancient VR Coaster has been released and rolled-out to everyone. 

We have followed the discussion groups and users remarks very close to make sure that everybody can enjoy this experience without any issues.

This updates fixes the following : 
- correct seated position 
- corrected the graphics / glitching issues
- changed lightning details 
- general performance improvement
- general visuals improvements

Next to that, we have created a sub-forum for support. If you experience some issue, please feel free to start a thread.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Thanks all for the discussions and remarks, here is a list of the current outstanding issues and remarks


Known issues : 

#1 Not starting in theater-mode
solution : Run Steam as normal but turn off Steam VR , and then launch your game

 #2 Seat Position 
will be updated and resolved in the next update 

#3 Glitching / GFX
While on some systems it runs great, while others suffer glitches. This will be updated soon with new GFX

#4 no editor
It was not the plan to create you're own ride, purely as an coaster experience ( like real life of a few minutes) or a showcase to show your friends

#5 Random 'not starting'
Please drop us an email when you are experience startup issue, we would lik e to receive more information about this. So please provide us some information so we can look into that.
